findings.highlight: if he just says he wasn't there.
findings.evidenceJa: たまたまそこにいたと言われたら
findings.governingReading: たまたまそこにいた concedes being in the woods but explains it as coincidental, insufficient to prove involvement.
findings.explanation: A coincidence excuse becomes a denial of presence.

findings.highlight: erase all the sigils at school
findings.evidenceJa: 校舎内の呪刻を消せる
findings.governingReading: The first line says most active marks have been erased; the following surprise concerns how quickly marks in the school could be erased, without all.
findings.explanation: The rapid sigil work gains an all-erased scope.

findings.governingReading: 魔術師って認めない gives the threshold for classifying/acknowledging someone as a mage, explaining why his weak energy was not identified that way.
findings.explanation: Recognition as a mage becomes approval of the person.

findings.highlight: I doubt there's such a convenient tool
findings.evidenceJa: 道具なんて少ないでしょう
findings.governingReading: 少ないでしょう gives rarity as the reason she thinks there probably is no Master using one.
findings.explanation: Rare tools become doubting that such a tool exists.

findings.highlight: tells me just how flustered she is.
findings.evidenceJa: 照れ隠しをしているのは一目瞭然
findings.governingReading: 照れ隠しをしているのは一目瞭然 identifies the obvious masking function of her bluster.
findings.explanation: Recognizing concealment of embarrassment becomes recognizing fluster.

findings.highlight: a good guy even though he's such a misanthrope.
findings.evidenceJa: 捻くれてるけどいいヤツ
findings.governingReading: Rin calls Archer contrary or difficult, but good, childlike, and enjoyable company.
findings.explanation: Rin calls Archer contrary in Japanese; the English more specifically describes him as disliking people, while retaining her judgment that he is good.
